instruction: stack the blocks from bottom to top in the order of blue, yellow, and orange, then reset the robot arm.

arguments.note: I will pick up yellow first and place it on blue, leaving blue on the table. I am turning the left gripper toward a downward grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Yellow lifted securely. I will carry it above blue, which remains on the table at approximately the same front-back position.

arguments.note: The intermediate carry landed accurately and yellow is secure. I will continue toward blue.

arguments.note: The elevated reach to blue is outside the planner's range. I will try a lower transfer height that still keeps yellow clear of blue.

arguments.note: Yellow is directly above blue with a small clearance. I will lower nine millimetres, then check alignment before contact.
